Left (aim): pins a glowing star in the air, up to 5; each new one joins the previous with a constellation of light. Right: glide along the light rails from star to star, trailing stardust. Friends who right-click you within 3 blocks hitch on behind like train cars. Sneak + right clears the stars; sneak + left removes the last. Scroll: speed. Stars fade after 5 min. No damage.
ability.infinity.space_stone.cosmic_scal: Left (aim at a build): space stretches in blue and the connected structure (up to 4000 built blocks) swells 2x or 3x from its base, layer by layer. Right: shrinks it to 1/2 or 1/3 by sampling each cell. Sneak + click on two blocks selects an A/B box instead of the structure. Scroll: factor. Respects claims and unbreakable blocks.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.telepathic_l: Left (aim): pings the spot with a golden beam that you and your party (or players within 128 blocks) see through walls for 20 s. Right: menu of thought bubbles (Danger!, Come here, Loot, Help, Wait, Nice) that float over your head for 5 s. Scroll: marker colour. No damage.
ability.infinity.mind_stone.borrowed_eye: Left (aim at a player, or a menu of players within 256 blocks): your sight moves into their eyes while your body stays behind as a kneeling golden shell. Sneak to return. Right (aim): Confusion, which swaps the target's movement controls and makes their view drift. Scroll: duration.
